ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between low-intensity dark perimeter pigments and mid-intensity mottled interior regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigment contiguous along the trailing edges and central peduncle junction, with extensive irregular mid-intensity blue-grey mottling across the interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curves tapering to sharp distal tips with an upward recurve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-intensity white clusters indicative of barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, unaligned dark linear disruptions visible on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters at the tips of both fluke lobes; various superficial linear scratches across the ventral surface.
